# MSIMS (Motion and Simulation System)

> MSIMS (Motion and Simulation System) is a simulator and VR developer based in Batu Caves, Selangor, Malaysia. It designs and builds training simulators end to end: software, control hardware and Motion Base. Its simulators and VR modules cover agriculture, fisheries, oil palm, maritime and port operations, construction machinery and off-road driving.

MSIMS Tech Services, No. 17A, Jalan SG 8/7, Taman Sri Gombak, 68100 Batu Caves, Selangor, Malaysia. Email sales@msims.tech, phone +6017-22 33 070.

## Pages

- [MSIMS home (English)](https://msims.tech/): sectors, platform, full simulator catalogue, services, clients, FAQ and enquiry form

## Agricultural simulators

- Paddy Combine Harvester Simulator (Simulator; ready to supply): Harvest, transplant and plough in the paddy field with a combine harvester, rice transplanter and disc-plough tractor. The instrument panel and control tablet change with the selected machine.
- Agricultural Drone Simulator (Simulator; ready to supply): From equipment introduction and basic controls to spraying fertiliser and pesticide over paddy fields, Harumanis mango orchards and corn fields.
- VR Farming (VR module; ready to supply): Farm tasks done by hand in VR, from planting paddy seedlings to milking a cow, for exhibitions and schools.
- VR MyGAP (VR module; ready to supply): MyGAP certification good practices explored step by step on a virtual farm.
- VR Durian & Strawberry Farm (VR module; ready to supply): A virtual visit to durian and strawberry farms for exhibitions and learning.
- SIM-TANI 3-in-1 (Simulator; demo available): Three machines in one program: combine harvester, rice transplanter and rotovator tractor. Work-area coverage is tracked plot by plot.

## Fisheries simulators

- Fishing Vessel Simulator (Simulator; ready to supply): Purse seine and trawl operations with six-degree-of-freedom vessel physics, rough weather and night sailing.
- VR Trawl Crew (VR module; ready to supply): An expo module that puts visitors on the deck of a trawler, complete with winch controls.
- VR Sayangi Laut Kita (VR module; ready to supply): Dive in Malaysia's marine parks as a conservation diver: collecting rubbish and propagating coral against the clock.
- VR Purse Seine Crew (VR module; demo available): Players become the crew of a fishing vessel: lowering the fish aggregating device, setting the net and hauling in the catch with hand controllers.

## Oil palm simulators

- SIM-SAWIT Haulage (Simulator; demo available): Hauling fresh fruit bunches with a mini tractor and trailer on an oil palm estate. Modules are structured in line with oil palm mechanisation training.

## Maritime & port simulators

- Patrol Boat Mission Simulator (Simulator; demo available): Six short missions inspired by maritime enforcement duties in Malaysian waters, including patrols around the Langkawi islands. Suited to exhibition visitors.
- NAKHODA Ship Simulator (Simulator; demo available): Ship handling with a ship control console, real-time sea waves and guided control calibration.
- STS Crane Simulator (Simulator; ready to supply): A ship-to-shore crane with container sway physics, sequenced bay plans and weather that affects trolley sway.

## Construction machinery simulators

- Excavator Simulator (Simulator; demo available): A crawler excavator from the cab view, with two joystick levers as the left and right consoles.
- Backhoe Loader Simulator (Simulator; demo available): A backhoe loader with particle soil physics, working hydraulic rams and an engine start-up sequence before work begins.
- Forklift Simulator (Simulator; demo available): Seven forklift training modules aligned with the requirements of OSHA 1994, DOSH and NIOSH.

## Off-road driving simulators

- 4WD Off-Road Driving Simulator (Simulator; in development): About 3 km of village road and 3 km of off-road trail through rubber and oil palm estates, to experience four-wheel-drive features.

## Services

- System sales: complete simulator and VR systems, installed and tested on site
- Exhibition rental: simulator and VR units for expos, open days and outreach programmes
- Custom development: new simulators or VR modules for an organisation's own machinery, curriculum and procedures
